name: The City · Districts and Key Locations

text.content:
Zone Held By Hunting Notes
Downtown and Pioneer Square Prince (surface) / Nosferatu (below ground) Difficulty 3 Tourists and the unhoused. Hunting is watched.
Capitol Hill Toreador Difficulty 2 Nightlife; the city's rack.
Ballard and the north Unclaimed Difficulty 4 Residential neighborhood. The three kids in @UUID[JournalEntry.zNhdOMSnEHdvMIGE]{Helen Ward's Voice Memos #7} were killed there.
Harbor Island and Elliott Bay Sheriff, ceded to David Difficulty 3 Night-shift workers.
South Lake Union Unclaimed Difficulty 5 Cameras everywhere. FIRSTLIGHT territory.
Eastside (Bellevue) Halloway Difficulty 4 Money, private security, Gale Sentinel.
Everett Anarchs Difficulty 3 Shipyards and naval bases.
Tacoma Nobody and everybody Difficulty 3 Exiles, Sabbat remnants, the Hecata funeral home.
